This is a lesson on one drum groove the [Backing Track](../../tools/backing-track.qmd) band plays: **Waltz in one**. It is built up from a simpler pattern, one step at a time, and every step is played by the band and written out as it plays. How the examples work: press ▶ Play, switch players in and out with the buttons beside it, and read the band's last four bars on the staff underneath. The tempo slider at the bottom of the page slows everything down.

[All the accompaniment patterns](index.qmd) · [Drum grooves](index.qmd#drums)

## The pattern

For a quick 3/4: kick on 1, a brushed snare on 2 and 3. Four bars make one phrase: the kick leans on the first and third, the snare answers in the second and fourth, and the fourth leads back in. In 4/4 it is the two-beat.

It belongs in *Waltz (in one)*, *Boom-chick* and *Folk carol*. Here it is in the waltz (in one) style with the whole band. Switch the other players off to hear it alone.

## Step 1: Two-beat

Start with something simpler. Kick with the bass on 1 and 3, a soft snare with the chords on 2 and 4. In 3/4: kick on 1, snare on 2 and 3.

This is a pattern of its own: [the lesson on it](drums-boomchick.qmd) takes it further. Here it is only a step on the way, slowly. The drums play alone first; switch the bass and chords on when it is steady.

<div class="ar-demo" data-style="waltz" data-chart="C|C|F|F|G7|G7|C|C" data-tempo="106" data-on="drums" data-staves="drums" data-meter="3/4" data-choice-label="Step:" data-choices='[{"label":"Two-beat","opts":{"groove":"boomchick"}}]'></div>

## Step 2: Waltz in one, slowly

Now the pattern itself. Compare it with the step before: press each button while the band plays and watch what changes on the staff.

**How to play it.** Kick on 1, brushed snare on 2 and 3, felt in one. Lean on the first and third bars of each four-bar phrase.

<div class="ar-demo" data-style="waltz" data-chart="C|C|F|F|G7|G7|C|C" data-tempo="106" data-on="drums" data-staves="drums" data-meter="3/4" data-choice-label="Compare:" data-choices='[{"label":"Waltz in one","opts":{"groove":"waltz"}},{"label":"Two-beat (the step before)","opts":{"groove":"boomchick"}}]'></div>

The whole band, at 150 beats a minute. Play along, then switch the band's drum kit off and take the part yourself.
